text:
faye: Noticed samples are producing duplicate webhook deliveries after the new retry middleware. ~0.5% in staging.
ops-bot: deploy: dotnet-sdk@4.0.0 rolled to staging (2026-04-05T07:40:00Z) :rocket:
noah: Do we have traces? key: are receivers returning Retry-After as seconds or HTTP-date?
faye: Example sanitized log:
```
POST /hooks -> 429
Headers: Retry-After: 5
client retry #1 after 0.2s -> 200 (duplicate)
```
rachel: Found that .NET change parses Retry-After with int.TryParse only and treats parse failure as immediate retry. Also jitter was +/- which could yield negative sleep in rare cases.
noah: Fix plan: 1) SDKs parse Retry-After both ways (int and HTTP-date). 2) Jitter must be non-negative. 3) Samples should send X-Redwood-Webhook-Id uuid4 by default. 4) Emit metric webhook_duplicate_rate.
rachel: Quick C# snippet to parse:
```csharp
var ra = resp.Headers["Retry-After"];
if (int.TryParse(ra, out var secs)) wait = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(secs);
else if (DateTime.TryParseExact(ra, "r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, DateTimeStyles.AdjustToUniversal, out var dt)) wait = dt - DateTime.UtcNow;
wait = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Math.Max(1, wait.TotalSeconds)) + TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(rand.Next(0, jitterMs));
```
noah: Also add CI lint to fail samples that don't attach idempotency header or explicit opt-out. Add staging smoke test simulating numeric and date RA.
faye: Assign: rachel -> SDK PR, noah -> CI + smoke, faye -> release notes + telemetry dashboard. ETA EOD.
rachel: Opening PR now, will include unit tests for int/date/expired-date cases.
faye: Thanks all :thumbsup:
